intentionalInlineChanges.scope: Homepage activity previews only: getActivityExcerpt, renderActivities and preview fields in buildHomeFeedItems.
intentionalInlineChanges.reason: Reviewer confirmed full announcements overwhelm the homepage timeline. Bound previews to 180 Unicode code points and three visual lines, retain course/category/status/location metadata, and expose a bilingual accessible action opening the existing full-detail modal.
beforeEvidence: renderActivities inserted escapeHtml(activity.intro) without a finite excerpt or visible detail cue; the button name included the full body.
Announcement intro joined item.category and item.content; event intro joined status, category, summary/content and location.
afterEvidence: getActivityExcerpt collapses whitespace and limits preview text to 180 Unicode code points plus an ellipsis; renderActivities also applies it to local/fallback previews.
Announcements and events prefer summary over content for previews; previewMeta retains category and event status/location outside the three-line activity-excerpt clamp.
The existing translated common.viewDetailsArrow supplies the visible cue and title/date/metadata aria-label, with explicit zh/en fallback; existing language-change refresh rerenders it.

The existing data-feed-id click handler, content/meta/title/date/link assignments and openFeedModal/closeFeedModal are unchanged. Source outside the activity render/build region is byte-identical to beforeSha256; original import map, IDs, links and frozen dependencies remain enforced.
